title: fix(app-shell): the metadata directory's "View all issues" link takes the sweep's tone, so warnings only are not painted as errors (objectui#12768)
body:
Fixes #12768
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The metadata directory (Setup, then All Metadata Types) shows a "View all issues (N)" link when its diagnostics sweep returns anything. The directory reads that sweep with severity `warning`, so N counts items whose only diagnostics are warnings, yet the link was always destructive: red border, red text, alert triangle. An app with warnings and no errors saw a red alert link.

The link now takes its tone from `diagnosticsHeaderTone`, the rule the Diagnostics page header already uses (objectui#12721, merged as `a214fbe`), over the same entries:

- Any entry invalid or carrying errors: the destructive look, unchanged (`border-destructive/40 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive`, alert triangle).
- Warnings only: the amber the Diagnostics header paints for warnings (`border-amber-500/40 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300`, with matching hover classes), alert triangle kept.
- No entries: no link, as before.

The link's text (`engine.directory.diagnosticsLink`), its count and its destination (`./_diagnostics`) are unchanged. The link also carries `data-tone`, as the header's icon and badge do.

`diagnosticsHeaderTone` and its `DiagnosticsHeaderTone` type moved, unchanged, from `DiagnosticsPage.tsx` into a module-local `diagnostics-tone.ts` beside both pages, and both pages import it: one rule, not a second copy. Neither `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` nor `views/metadata-admin/index.ts` changed, so `MetadataDirectoryPage` and `MetadataDiagnosticsPage` stay as they were. The per-type tiles below the link already split invalid from warning counts and are unchanged.

Files: `DirectoryPage.tsx`, `DiagnosticsPage.tsx` (the move only), the new `diagnostics-tone.ts`, a test beside the directory page, and `.changeset/12768-directory-diagnostics-link-tone.md` (app-shell patch).

## Reproduction and readings

Backend for the browser readings: objectstack `66d456d01`, `examples/app-showcase` on a `--fresh` database, with the console served from this branch's worktree in vite dev.

A warnings-only sweep is not reachable from that backend. Its diagnostics verdict (`computeMetadataDiagnostics` in `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`) is either `valid: true` with no warnings or `valid: false` with errors, and `decorateMetadataItem` recomputes it on every read, so no stored item can carry warnings either. The live showcase sweep answered `total: 0` at both severities (396 items, 27 types). So the browser readings inject entries into the live `/meta/diagnostics` answer with a Playwright route double, against the real `DirectoryPage` and the real `useGlobalDiagnostics`.

The "View all issues" link on `/apps/setup/metadata`, Chromium at 1280 px:

| sweep | before (`main` `6e4f144`) | after (`e6031c3`) |
|---|---|---|
| one warnings-only entry | classes `border-destructive/40 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive`; color `rgb(239, 68, 68)` | classes `border-amber-500/40 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-500/10 hover:text-amber-700 dark:hover:text-amber-300`; color `oklch(0.555 0.163 48.998)`; `data-tone="warning"` |
| one invalid and one warnings-only entry | not read in the browser; the test pins it green on `main` | the same four destructive classes; color `rgb(239, 68, 68)`; `data-tone="error"` |
| no entries | no link | no link |

On the Diagnostics page the link opens, with the same doubled sweep, the "Errors + Warnings" tab's summary badge reads color `oklch(0.555 0.163 48.998)` (`text-amber-700`), the value the link now has.

Test `DirectoryPage.diagnosticsLinkTone-12768.test.tsx` renders the real `DirectoryPage` with the real `useGlobalDiagnostics` against a fake client. Three pins:

- Warnings only: amber, no destructive class. Red on unchanged `main` (`Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`, the received class list was the destructive one); green after.
- An error present: today's four destructive classes. Green on `main` by design (no-regression guard); green after.
- Clean: no link. Green on `main`; green after.

Ablation, run once and not kept. Each leg went through `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode over this test and `DiagnosticsPage.headerTone-12721.test.tsx`, and was restored to the HEAD blob, checked by hash, with `git diff HEAD` empty:

- A1, the tone forced to `error` whenever there are entries: the warnings-only pin turns red (1 failed, 6 passed).
- A2, the shared helper's error branch deleted: the directory's error pin and the Diagnostics header's "errors present" pin both turn red (2 failed, 5 passed), so both surfaces read the one rule.
- A3, the link's visibility condition opened to a zero count: the clean pin turns red (1 failed, 6 passed).

## Local gates, on `e6031c3`

- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --concurrency=2`: 28 of 28 tasks successful, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit`, then `tsconfig.test.json`, whose file list includes the new test and module): exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the new test, `DiagnosticsPage.headerTone-12721.test.tsx`, `DirectoryPage.environmentOverlay-12141.test.tsx` and `PermissionMatrixEditor.readonly.test.tsx` (every suite under `views/metadata-admin/` that names `DirectoryPage`, `DiagnosticsPage` or `useGlobalDiagnostics`): 4 files, 24 tests passed.
- Also `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` and `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts`: 2 files, 43 tests passed.
- eslint on the four changed source and test files: exit 0, no errors. One existing `no-explicit-any` warning on the `client.list` call is outside this diff.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims` and `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations): exit 0 each.
- Every other family is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- Reach today: no live backend produces a warnings-only sweep (above), so on objectstack `66d456d01` no administrator sees this state. The server's own doc comment on its sweep says warnings "are reserved for a future lint layer". This change makes the link agree with the Diagnostics header for when that layer lands. Observation, not filed; carrier: none.
- Same family, measured only through the browser double: on the Diagnostics page's "Errors + Warnings" tab, the per-type count badge beside each type heading is always destructive, so a warnings-only group shows a red count under the amber header. Left unchanged here, because this claim allows `DiagnosticsPage.tsx` only the move. It is in the report for the seat to route.
- The link opens the Diagnostics page on its "Errors" tab with a sweep that is not scoped to the active package, while the directory counts a package-scoped `warning` sweep. With the doubled warnings-only sweep, the page first reads "0 issue(s) across 396 items in 27 types" with a green check, and the amber appears only on "Errors + Warnings". Observation, not filed; carrier: none.
